title: A smooth compactly supported kernel with the mean value property for harmonic functions
statement: For every n >= 1 there is a C^infinity function rho : R^n -> R with rho(z) = 0 whenever |z| >= 1 such that for every C^2 function h : R^n -> R, every x0 in R^n and every t > 0 with Laplacian(h)(y) = 0 for all y in closedBall(x0, t): int_{R^n} t^{-n} rho(t^{-1} y) h(x0 - y) dy = h(x0).
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∃ ρ : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ρ ∧ (∀ z : Rn n, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → ρ z = 0) ∧ ∀ (h : Rn n → ℝ) (x₀ : Rn n) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → ContDiff ℝ 2 h → (∀ y ∈ closedBall x₀ t, Laplacian.laplacian h y = 0) → ∫ y, t⁻¹ ^ n * ρ (t⁻¹ • y) * h (x₀ - y) = h x₀
